proof_summary: For \(N=201886\cdot3^{39101}-1\), modular exponentiation in \((\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z)[\theta]/(\theta^2-4\theta+1)\) establishes an \(N+1\) primality certificate: \(\theta^{N+1}=1\), the \(\theta\)-coefficient of \(\theta^{(N+1)/3}\) is a unit, and the discriminant \(12\) is a unit. Consequently every prime divisor \(r\mid N\) has \(3^{39101}\mid r-1\) or \(3^{39101}\mid r+1\); since \(N<(3^{39101}-1)^2\), this forces \(N\) to be prime, providing the witness \(m=39101\).
